objective: Recover a bound Earth orbit: lowest point ≥150 km, highest point ≤600 km; coast without thrust for five seconds.
unavailable: Flight data unavailable. Release thrust while instruments recover.
primaryChanged: Earth is no longer the orbit reference. Release thrust and inspect your trajectory; Retry starts at Earth.
escape: This trajectory escapes Earth. Release thrust. Align prograde with Z, then try short reverse burns with B.
highApoapsis: The highest point is too high. Release thrust. Align prograde with Z, then use short reverse burns with B while watching the highest point.
release: Safe orbit reached. Release Space/B to begin the five-second coast.
coast: Keep thrust off while the safe orbit is confirmed.
align: Release thrust and point along Earth’s relative motion. Z can align you; wait for alignment before burning.
recover: Hold Space to raise the lowest point to at least 150 km; keep the highest point at or below 600 km. Z can maintain orbit alignment.
belowTarget: The lowest point is below the safety target.
resetBurn: Confirmation restarted because propulsion was applied.
resetUnsafe: Confirmation restarted because the orbit no longer meets the safety limits.
resetUnknown: Confirmation restarted; check the safe-orbit limits and keep thrust off.
hintRecover: Periapsis is the predicted lowest point above Earth. Forward thrust while pointing prograde raises it here. Negative means the predicted path intersects Earth. Aim for at least 150 km, with the highest point at most 600 km.
hintAlign: Z aligns your nose and roll to the orbit without thrust. V aligns only the nose; use Z to place Earth above before burning.
hintCoast: Safe prediction alone is not completion. Release both thrust controls and coast for five active seconds. A burn or lost safety restarts confirmation; explicit pause preserves earned time.
hintCorrection: Release first, align prograde, then try short B burns. Reverse thrust may lower both highest and lowest points; watch both limits. Recovery is not guaranteed. P opens pause and Retry.
hintUnavailable: Unavailable values do not establish safety. Release thrust; if Earth data does not recover, pause with P and Retry.
hintStall: Hold Space rather than tapping it; release when the lowest point reaches the target.
showOrbit: Press G to show your predicted orbit line. Inspect its path around Earth before burning.
hintOrbit: G toggles the orbit line. Inspect the predicted path around Earth, then press Z to align the nose along it and roll Earth above the ship.
orientOrbit: Press Z to align to your orbit. Wait until Earth is above the ship and the nose follows the orbit line, then thrust.
hintOrientOrbit: Z toggles orbit attitude assistance: it points the nose along Earth-relative motion and rolls Earth above the ship without firing the engine. Wait for the view to settle, then hold Space.
